greeting: Hi! I'm the Trini Hub assistant. Ask me about dog registration, reporting community issues with CivSnap, forms, scanning files, or your account. I can also point you to the right screen.
disclaimer: I answer from a curated help guide. I can't access your personal data and won't give legal advice — for account-specific help, contact support.
fallback: I'm not sure about that one yet. Here are some things I can help with — tap a topic or rephrase your question.

faqs.question: How do I register a dog?
faqs.answer: To register a dog, open External Services → Dog Registration. Fill in the owner details, the dog's name, breed and wellness information, then submit. You'll get a confirmation and can track approval status from Home under "Pending submissions".
related: Where do I see my submission status?
Can staff register a dog for me?

faqs.question: Where do I see my submission status?
faqs.answer: Your dog registration submissions appear on the Home screen under "Pending submissions", and in full under Dog Registration → View submissions. A badge shows whether each one is pending or approved.
related: How do I register a dog?

faqs.question: How do I report a community issue?
faqs.answer: Use CivSnap: open External Services → CivSnap, then "Log a new issue". Take or attach a photo — it's auto-geotagged — add a short title and description, and submit. Nearby residents can then vote to raise its priority.
related: How does voting on issues work?
Why does it check for nearby issues?

faqs.question: How does voting on issues work?
faqs.answer: In the CivSnap community feed, signed-in residents can vote on an existing report instead of creating a duplicate. More votes signal higher priority to the responsible corporation. You need to be signed in to vote.
related: How do I report a community issue?

faqs.question: How do I find and submit a form?
faqs.answer: Open Forms from either Internal or External Services. Browse the available forms, fill one in, and submit. You can resume drafts and track each submission's status from the same hub.
related: How do I scan a file?

faqs.question: How do I scan a file?
faqs.answer: Scan File uses your device camera to read a file's QR code and log its movement (checked out or received) against your account. Staff can also show a personal, rotating badge QR so a file handover can be logged to the right person. Open it from Internal or External Services → Scan File.
related: How do I report a community issue?

faqs.question: How do I find a file or record?
faqs.answer: Use Find File under Internal or External Services. Enter a record ID or name and the reason for access, then submit the request. You can track it from request through to delivery.
related: How do I scan a file?

faqs.question: I'm having trouble signing in.
faqs.answer: From the login screen you can reset your password with "Forgot password" — you'll get an email link. Make sure you're using the email you registered with. If you still can't get in, contact support and they can check your account access.
related: How do I change my details?

faqs.question: How do I change my details?
faqs.answer: Open the menu and go to Profile to review your information, or Settings to change preferences like theme and reduced motion. Some fields are managed by an administrator.

faqs.question: Where are my notifications?
faqs.answer: If your role has notifications enabled, open the menu and choose Notifications to see updates about your reports and submissions.
related: Where do I see my submission status?

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
faqs.answer: For anything account-specific or urgent, reach the support team through the User Support Hub (staff can act on your behalf) or your organization's published support channel. I can help with how-to questions any time.
